description: This file defines a Gantt chart class used for rendering Gantt charts with tasks, dates, and visual elements. It includes methods for drawing the chart, calculating date ranges, and managing task placement on the timeline.

classes.name: Gantt
classes.description: Class responsible for generating and rendering a Gantt chart for project tasks, handling date calculations and HTML generation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Gantt chart with start/end dates and tasks, and drawing the grid if tasks are provided.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Method responsible for rendering the Gantt chart HTML, including month, day, and task rows.

methods.name: year_month
methods.description: Returns an array with the breakdown of the date span into years, months, and days.

methods.name: count_days
methods.description: Calculates the total number of days between two dates, inclusive.

methods.name: time_range
methods.description: Provides a human-readable difference between two dates in years, months, and days.

methods.name: substr_unicode
methods.description: Utility to substring unicode strings correctly.

methods.name: IsNullOrEmptyString
methods.description: Checks if a string is null, empty, or only whitespace.
